scope: Per-node clean builds, upstream tests, package/Ubuntu upgrade and ABI client checks on KVM; graphical desktop and final distro integration remain later gates

attempts.cause: Sourcing /etc/os-release overwrote the shell VERSION variable; autopkgtest setup received the Ubuntu display version. Original result.version is preserved as invalid; package identity is independently verified in .dsc/.changes/.deb.
attempts.repair: Use PACKAGE_VERSION for the frozen Debian candidate; rerun only this node on a fresh runner.

attempts.cause: Strict byte comparison rejected PNG tIME timestamps normalized by dh_strip_nondeterminism. Every other PNG chunk, including IDAT, is unchanged.
attempts.repair: Compare every PNG chunk except its validated tIME field; preserve exact byte hashes for other resources. Regression rejects changed pixels and invalid CRC.

review.upstream_changes: Official 6.7.5 signed resources; no upstream code patches.
review.packaging_changes: Retain Ubuntu names, linux-any and theme paths; update owner/VCS, SPDX licenses and autopkgtests.
review.build_dependencies: Only debhelper-compat (=13); no Qt or Frameworks dependency.
review.test_policy: No upstream build tests exist for this resource-only source; non-superficial integrity/font/reference and Ubuntu upgrade tests added. PNG timestamps may be normalized by debhelper; every rendering/content chunk remains exact.
review.activation_policy: Installs resources only; does not enable the theme or rewrite boot configuration.

local_retention.duplicate_binary_role: autopkgtest retains an additional identical testbed copy of the candidate .deb

review.upstream_changes: Signed official 6.7.5; no upstream code patches. All 64 regular resources and 14 sound aliases preserved.
review.packaging_changes: Preserve source/binary name, Architecture all, Multi-Arch foreign and upstream CMake defaults; correct SPDX license ownership; pin retained ECM.
review.build_dependencies: ECM 6.30.0-0supralinux3 supplied only through sbuild --extra-package, clean Ubuntu Qt 6.10 provider.
review.test_policy: No upstream tests exist; substantive exact resource-set/hash checks, freedesktop theme metadata, decoding of every audio stream and Ubuntu APT upgrade.
review.activation_policy: Installs sound theme resources; session selection and actual PipeWire playback remain integration gates.

attempts.cause: CMake selected KDEInstallDirs5 because Oxygen requests legacy ECM 5.102 and does not discover Qt itself. The valid sbuild failed at configure. Original sbuild_result=not-run is preserved as a runner-marker defect; the attempted build and configure failure are retained in sbuild.log.
attempts.repair: Set QT_MAJOR_VERSION=6 explicitly alongside KF5_SUPPORT=ON; preserve all legacy sounds and test in a fresh runner. Mark sbuild_result=FAIL before invoking sbuild so a failed execution retains its proper marker.

attempts.cause: The Qt 6 configure repair passed sbuild. Lintian rejected embedding the full LGPL-3 text instead of referring to the Debian common license.
attempts.repair: Use the standard LGPL-3 common-license reference while preserving the LGPL-3.0-or-later terms and all SPDX attributions; rerun the package checks and tests.

attempts.cause: Host DNS resolution of api.github.com failed during active package monitoring. The controller exited and shut down the VM during autopkgtest testbed setup. sbuild and lintian passed; no test completed and no original guest result or Actions artifact was produced.
attempts.repair: Retry read-only API transport after transient DNS/network/HTTP failures without repeating mutations. Certify recovery, permanent-error handling and a finite retry budget, then rerun Oxygen tests on a fresh KVM runner.

review.upstream_changes: Official signed 6.7.5 resources; no source patches. 115 installed resources including 63 aliases and all 50 legacy sound paths.
review.packaging_changes: Preserve Ubuntu epoch 4, binary identity and Multi-Arch foreign. Use QT_MAJOR_VERSION=6 with KF5_SUPPORT=ON; both are required because Oxygen requests legacy ECM 5.102 without a Qt discovery call. Update SPDX attribution including the camera-shutter CC-BY-3.0 author. Use the Debian LGPL-3 common-license reference as required by lintian.
review.build_dependencies: Exact retained ECM 6.30.0-0supralinux3 through sbuild --extra-package; Ubuntu Qt 6.10. No implicit preinstallation.
review.test_policy: No upstream test suite; verify exact dpkg-owned resources, byte hashes, alias targets, metadata and decoding of every current and legacy stream, plus Ubuntu APT upgrade.
review.activation_policy: Install upstream sound resources only; session selection and PipeWire playback remain integration gates.

attempts.cause: sbuild and all four actual CTest entries passed. The verifier incorrectly required exactly three entries and rejected the additional appstreamtest generated by ECM. The original runner FAIL is retained; this is a verification-gate false negative, not a failing upstream test.
attempts.repair: Require all declared upstream tests and account for every executed CTest entry, including ECM additions. Capture binaries/buildinfo/changes before post-build verification so a future validation failure retains those outputs. Retry only KDecoration in a fresh KVM runner.

review.upstream_changes: Signed official stable 6.7.5; upstream source unchanged. Requires Qt >=6.10 and Frameworks >=6.26, satisfied by Ubuntu Qt and selected Frameworks.
review.packaging_changes: Preserve epoch 4, three binary names, Multi-Arch same, historical Breaks/Replaces and public/private SONAMEs. Retain Ubuntu symbol lists to reject missing exports. Refresh SPDX attribution and enable upstream CTest.
review.build_dependencies: Exact retained ECM 6.30.0-0supralinux3 and KI18n 6.30.0-0supralinux1 including its required binary closure; Ubuntu Qt 6.10.
review.test_policy: Require all three upstream CTest tests, then run the unchanged client compiled and exercised against Ubuntu libraries before the candidate upgrade; compile a second client against candidate headers, inspect SONAMEs and check APT.
review.activation_policy: Libraries only. Real KWin decoration plugins and a graphical Wayland desktop remain integration gates.

attempts.cause: Resource tests compared ImageMagick PNG date:create/date:modify bytes strictly. Debian normalized those two valid timestamp fields; IDAT, EXIF and every other chunk of the rejected Shell screenshot are unchanged.
attempts.repair: Validate CRC and timestamp syntax; normalize only date:create/date:modify values while preserving keys/order and every other PNG chunk. Regression rejects changed pixels, author metadata, malformed dates and CRC corruption.

review.upstream_changes: Signed official 6.7.5; all 37 wallpaper sets and 288 resources, including 143 safe image aliases. No source modifications.
review.packaging_changes: Preserve Ubuntu epoch 4, binary name and Architecture all. Correct per-wallpaper authors/licenses from upstream metadata; preserve root and Debian references. Use explicit Qt 6 for legacy ECM setup and declare the Qt provider.
review.build_dependencies: Exact retained ECM 6.30.0-0supralinux3 through explicit sbuild input; qt6-base-dev from Ubuntu 6.10.
review.test_policy: No upstream tests. Exact dpkg-owned resource coverage, safe aliases, metadata and decode of 108 unique images. PNG CRCs and all chunks remain exact except valid tIME and date:create/date:modify timestamp values normalized by Debian; regression rejects pixel/author changes and malformed metadata. Original Attempt 1 FAIL preserved; real installed payload passed the repaired local verifier. KVM rerun required.
review.activation_policy: Installs the complete additional wallpaper collection; default wallpaper remains part of Breeze and session integration.
review.rootfs_policy: Admit immutable bare milestone buildd base by digest, Ubuntu identity and absence of Frameworks/Qt SDK. Replace only APT sources with all three signed Ubuntu suites; sbuild updates/upgrades every disposable build. Infrastructure ECM/Qt consumer must pass before a package Attempt.

attempts.cause: The >4096-byte inline base64 setup line was truncated by the autopkgtest QEMU serial terminal; the Ubuntu baseline script became empty and both ABI/consumer tests lacked their required baseline files. Build, lintian and installed resource test passed; compatibility execution is incomplete.
attempts.repair: Transport reviewed baseline setup as bounded base64 lines, verify its SHA-256 in the guest before executing, and certify the transport in a small KVM probe before repeating the package.

attempts.cause: Minimal Ubuntu baseline testbed installed gcc without its recommended C development headers; compilation stopped at missing assert.h before candidate tests. The original runner classified exit 16 as INFRA_INVALID; sbuild and lintian passed.
attempts.repair: Declare build-essential explicitly in the Ubuntu baseline setup and consumer test dependencies; run the exact reviewed Ubuntu baseline client in a disposable nested KVM preflight before repeating the package.

review.upstream_changes: Signed official stable 6.7.5, no upstream code patches. Text plugin uses Ubuntu Plymouth headers and libraries; graphical theme uses the Ubuntu script/label-pango runtime.
review.packaging_changes: Preserve Ubuntu name, architecture, hardening and maintainer scripts. Configure SupraLINUX title through supported upstream CMake options. Correct SPDX-specific license stanzas and declare fonts-noto-core/plymouth-label. Keep correct upstream plugin/theme install directories.
review.build_dependencies: Exact retained ECM 6.30.0-0supralinux3; all C/Plymouth SDK/providers from Ubuntu. No Qt provider replacement. Immutable bare buildd admission with explicit current Ubuntu suites/update/distupgrade.
review.test_policy: No automated upstream suite. Host resource fixture passed: 89 exact resources, 84 decoded PNGs, metadata and both color-depth spinner branches. Ubuntu SDK client compiled syntax checked; real baseline and unchanged binary post-upgrade execution in boot/shutdown/updates modes, prompt/progress/lifecycle without display views plus newly compiled consumer remain KVM gates. Normalize only validated PNG time/date fields, retaining pixel/other metadata identity; the source fixture passes this policy. Attempt 1 exposed serial setup truncation before the baseline executed; transport repair is independently certified before repeat. Declare the libevdev/libudev/libxkbcommon SDK dependencies required by Ubuntu Plymouth pkg-config for actual C compilation. Explicit build-essential provides the compiler and C development headers even with no-install-recommends. The exact Ubuntu baseline client must compile and run in the nested KVM preflight before another package Attempt.
review.activation_policy: Theme package installs plugin/resources; daemon/display rendering, initramfs theme selection and real BIOS/UEFI boot remain distro integration gates.

review.upstream_changes: Signed stable 6.7.5. Uses Ubuntu Qt 6.10 private Wayland SDK without replacement.
review.packaging_changes: Preserve four Ubuntu binaries, public SONAME 6, symbol guards and Multi-Arch metadata. Correct SPDX choices/full BSD license from signed sources. Exact retained ECM and Ubuntu Qt/Wayland providers.
review.build_dependencies: Qt minimum 6.10 and private Wayland provider from Ubuntu; ECM minimum 6.26 fulfilled by exact retained 6.30.0-0supralinux3.
review.test_policy: No automated upstream suite; upstream test is a graphical example. All 27 LayerShell methods/signals used by the client were reviewed against the hash-verified Ubuntu 6.6.4 SDK. Test unchanged Ubuntu binary after complete four-binary upgrade, public window properties/signals, actual Qt shell plugin load, QML attached-property behavior without compositor, SONAME/dependencies and rebuilt client. Real compilation/runtime remain KVM execution gates.
review.activation_policy: Library/plugin/QML package gate does not certify real compositor surfaces; full Plasma Wayland integration remains a later gate.

attempts.cause: Both functional clients and candidate builds completed successfully, but autopkgtest rejected expected D-Bus activation messages on stderr. A startup race also allowed a second daemon to be auto-activated before the owned process registered its service.
attempts.repair: Allow expected stderr while preserving exit-code checks and logs; wait for explicit owned daemon service registration before running clients and verify the owned PID stays alive.

review.upstream_changes: Signed official stable 6.7.5; preserve public KNightTime API, SONAME 0 and Ubuntu symbol guards. Source requires C++23, Ubuntu Qt >=6.10, Frameworks >=6.26.
review.packaging_changes: Preserve three Ubuntu binaries, multi-arch/installed paths and license declarations. Exact retained Frameworks inputs, tests enabled. Remove unused qt6-base-private-dev Build-Depends after signed source review found no Qt private header or target usage; clean build remains the gate.
review.build_dependencies: Exact ECM, KConfig, KCoreAddons, KDBusAddons, KHolidays and KI18n development dependencies plus their required binary dependency closure (27 hashes). These eligible retained artifacts preserve their original Frameworks evidence scope; this does not certify the entire Frameworks campaign. Ubuntu Qt/Positioning/compiler providers unchanged.
review.test_policy: Run all three upstream CTest suites. Before candidate build, compile and execute an Ubuntu client covering transitions/progress, timed and solar/polar schedules, cycle extrapolation, state serialization and public schedule provider. A real private D-Bus daemon must refresh the client with migrated custom schedules. Test the unchanged binary after complete three-package upgrade and recompile/retest a consumer. Checks remain active in Release builds. The Ubuntu and candidate transition relation implementations are identical: verify the exact 60-second tolerance boundaries; all grouped checks emit failure diagnostics. Expected D-Bus/Qt stderr is retained and allowed; nonzero checks still fail. Explicit bounded service readiness prevents auto-activation racing the owned daemon; the PID must remain alive before/after client execution.
review.activation_policy: Private disposable D-Bus session and config/state directories; configured timed schedule avoids geolocation. Full desktop night-color/compositor integration is a later gate.

attempts.cause: KConfig 6.30.0-0supralinux4 moves kconf_update from the Ubuntu libkf6config-bin package to libkf6configcore6 without matching Breaks/Replaces; apt upgrades the library first and dpkg rejects overwriting the Ubuntu-owned file. Build, Lintian and QFlatSetTest passed; candidate compatibility clients did not execute.
attempts.repair: Revalidate the affected KConfig predecessor with the Ubuntu-compatible file split and versioned ownership transition from the retained Supra revision, then refresh only affected predecessor inputs and rerun the Activities package gate.

review.upstream_changes: Signed stable 6.7.5; preserve Plasma::Activities public target, SONAME 7, Ubuntu symbols, CLI and QML APIs. C++20; Ubuntu Qt >=6.10, Frameworks >=6.26.
review.packaging_changes: Preserve six Ubuntu binaries and Multi-Arch metadata. Remove unused KF6WindowSystem/xkbcommon and obsolete Doxygen Build-Depends after complete signed source review. QDoc replaced BUILD_QCH upstream; retain a documentation package containing the explicit common optional documentation profile, with real QCH generation still a separate gate.
review.build_dependencies: Exact ECM/KConfig/KCoreAddons retained version and hash closure (13 binaries), eligible under their original Frameworks evidence scope. Retain Ubuntu Qt and Boost; bare clean sbuild certifies dependency sufficiency.
review.test_policy: Require upstream registered QFlatSetTest. Non-registered PlasmaActivitiesTest ignores qExec failures and is not inferred PASS from exit status. Before compilation, run an Ubuntu SDK client with offline behavior and the actual isolated Ubuntu kactivitymanagerd: create/rename/select/remove futures/signals, C++ model, installed QML plugin and CLI. Upgrade all six binaries and re-run the unchanged client, then rebuild and re-run the consumer. All failures report the check.
review.activation_policy: Private D-Bus and temporary XDG config/data/cache/state/runtime; offscreen Qt. Only owned daemon PID is terminated. Ubuntu daemon and Qt versions must remain unchanged; whole-desktop integration remains a later gate.
review.frameworks_revalidation: KConfig packaging-only revision 6.30.0-0supralinux5 passed authoritative KVM compilation, 90 upstream tests, source/binary lintian and Ubuntu/retained-Supra upgrades. Use its exact reviewed binaries; certify the new combined cache transport before a new Activities Attempt.

review.source: Official signed 6.7.5 source remains unmodified; verified Ubuntu packaging is advisory only.
review.version: Preserve Ubuntu epoch 4; candidate exceeds captured Ubuntu references.
review.profile: Preserve the ordinary KDED module profile with KPty libutempter support; no privileged executable fallback.
review.dependencies: Exact eligible ECM, KConfig repair, KCoreAddons, KDBusAddons, KI18n, KNotifications and KPty closure; retain Ubuntu Qt.
review.tests: No upstream CTest suite is defined. Run real installed-module/PTY/private notification tests with unchanged Ubuntu SDK binary and rebuilt consumer; real Plasma session integration remains separate.
review.compatibility: Preserve module namespace and notifyrc, resolve ELF dependencies and normal APT upgrade, retain Ubuntu Qt; no app or library ABI transition inferred from compilation alone.
review.licensing: Preserve GPL-2.0-or-later source terms and the explicit CC0-1.0 declaration for .gitlab-ci.yml, including its full text and Debian packaging attributions.
review.packaging: Use SupraLINUX VCS metadata; remove inherited Debian Salsa configuration and its unused alternate APT repository. The original Ubuntu advisory tree remains retained unchanged.

infrastructure_incidents.cause: Milestone parent directory mode 0750 did not permit the libvirt QEMU identity to traverse it. No guest, workflow or package execution started.
infrastructure_incidents.repair: Grant only libvirt-qemu read/traverse ACL on the dedicated milestone directory. Check POSIX access ACLs before creating an overlay; certify cache transport with the synthetic ECM/Qt consumer before Ocean.

infrastructure_incidents.cause: Large setup decoded and its SHA-256 matched, but the probe supplied Debian/control without a changelog. autopkgtest classified it as an unbuilt package source and failed extraction before running the test.
infrastructure_incidents.repair: Use the supported tests-only built-tree fixture; validate classification with the actual Ubuntu autopkgtest parser before another small KVM certification.

infrastructure_incidents.cause: The client expected Upcoming one second before start. Both Ubuntu 6.6.5 and official 6.7.5 classify it InProgress within the 60-second tolerance. The client compiled, then returned 1; autopkgtest stopped setup before candidate compilation.
infrastructure_incidents.repair: Exercise the exact -61/-60-second start and end boundaries and emit a descriptive diagnostic for every client failure; re-run the existing KVM Ubuntu preflight before sbuild.

package_input_certifications.inapplicability_reason: The outer disposable guest CPU policy and frozen execution-contract capture changed after a repeated KVM asynchronous page-fault stall. A new small authoritative input preflight is required before Activities sbuild.

package_input_incidents.cause: Nested QEMU blocked in kvm_async_pf_task_wait_schedule during Ubuntu baseline APT setup despite starting the outer guest with 8 GiB. The job ended before candidate source preparation or sbuild and before writing its runner result or uploading an Actions artifact; the sealed host observation retains the complete available payload.
package_input_incidents.repair: Disable kvm-asyncpf and kvm-asyncpf-int only in disposable outer build VMs, verify their actual QEMU CPU properties and KVM acceleration, then certify the repaired route with an authoritative preflight before the next package Attempt.
